replacements.new: - [x] State-space models. — ✅ `gmi-833-family-derivation-symbolic-ssm-retrieval-v1` M-FAM full recovery at the declared finite scope: an affine gate-free recurrent M_STREAM(2) machine (cells 2 <= cap 3, coefficients inside the frozen k=2 gate-free closure bound, cost 3, zero gate sites) realizes B_W2 task 1208 (lag-1 map (0,0,1,1)) and satisfies all three M-FAM clauses by independent-evaluator re-simulation — C1 gate-free/affine/recurrent with persistent state dim 2; C2 step-map superposition (1311 legal tests, all linear); C3 superposed memory (cell s0 pre-step = x[t-2]+x[t-1] at every position, nonzero history coefficients at lags {1,2}, task 1208 in the frozen k=2 closure's realized set). The V1 C3 report of 'delay-degenerate / any_superposed:false' is attributed to a probe artifact: the V1 probe inspected only k=1 sampled machines and only the PRE-step lag pair {1,0} (trajs[t] == a*x[t-1]+b*x[t], a,b nonzero), which is structurally impossible for causal pre-step states (they cannot depend on the current input x[t], forcing b=0); the same probe fires on POST-step states (cell 0, a=1, b=1) and the frozen k=2 closure (57 realized tasks) was never C3-probed.
